description: This file is the __init__.py for the torch.onnx package, defining exports, import statements, and functions related to exporting models to ONNX format in PyTorch.

classes.name: ONNXProgram
classes.description: Represents an exported ONNX model program.

classes.name: ExportableModule
classes.description: A module that can be exported to ONNX.

classes.name: OnnxExporterError
classes.description: Custom error class for ONNX export errors.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports a PyTorch model to ONNX format, supporting various options including dynamic axes, external data, and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: is_in_onnx_export
methods.description: Checks if the current context is within an ONNX export process.
